author: hoosier state today
title: MaPSAC elects new vice chair and emeritus members for 2026-27 term
text:
The Management and Professional Staff Advisory Committee elected a new vice chair and four nonvoting emeritus members for the 2026-27 term during its meeting on April 8.
Joey Woodyard, director of operations for the Purdue University Veterinary Hospital, was chosen as vice chair and will assume office on June 1. Amanda Hassenplug, who is currently serving as vice chair and is the lead research operations administrator for the Rosen Center for Advanced Computing, will become the committee’s chair at that time.
In addition to these leadership changes, four individuals were elected to serve one-year terms as emeritus members beginning June 1. The newly named emeritus members are Eric Adams, lead research operations administrator for education at the Rosen Center for Advanced Computing; Leslie Martin, assistant dean of administration in the College of Veterinary Medicine; Amanda Taylor, executive assistant to the head of the Department of Statistics; and Stephanie Winder, program coordinator in the School of Mechanical Engineering.
More information about MaPSAC can be found on its website. Those interested in joining MaPSAC may submit an online application through May 15.
These elections mark a transition period for MaPSAC leadership as it prepares for another year supporting management and professional staff.
